command: flock /tmp/sqll-machine.lock uv run --frozen --project harness python scripts/s3/speed_profile.py profile --scratch $SCRATCH
method: valgrind callgrind: the instruction count (Ir) of one run of the symbol build on the input of each benchmark; for each phase of PROFILE_PHASES, one more run that collects only the cost of that function and its callees (--toggle-collect). The symbol build is the source of the sessions with debug line tables and no strip (CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=line-tables-only, CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP=none); its stdout and exit code are those of the release build on each input. Self cost: the instructions of the function itself, summed over its files and recursion levels. The cost classes (COST_CLASSES) group the self costs by function name. Inclusive cost: with the callees; a recursive function can have more than 100%. Limit: Ir is not time (a cache miss costs time, not instructions); the estimates use Ir shares as time shares.

steps.step: the symbol build and the release build give the same stdout and exit code on the 112 inputs
